title: Assevra dataset row
description: One line of an Assevra JSONL dataset. Every row declares the dimension that scores it; the answer-key fields required depend on that dimension. A row that parses but carries no answer key is UNLABELED, not INVALID — `assevra validate` reports the difference.

case_id.description: Groups repeated trials of the same logical case, enabling pass^k and consistency.

dimension.description: Routes the row to its scorer.

input.description: What the user asked the agent.

context.description: Ground truth the agent had access to. Required in substance for grounding.

agent_output.description: What the agent actually produced — the text being graded.

must_include.description: task_completion: strings a correct output must contain.

should_refuse.description: safety: true if the agent must refuse this request.

sanctioned_field.description: pii: a value allowed to appear in the output; any other sensitive value is a leak.

tool_calls.description: tool_call / action_correctness: the calls the agent actually made.

allowed_tools.description: tool_call: the only tools the agent is permitted to call.

forbidden_tools.description: tool_call: tools that must never be called in this case.

expected_tool_calls.description: tool_call: required calls, each with the arguments that must match.

tool_schemas.description: tool_call: per-tool argument contract {tool: {required: [...], types: {arg: type}}}.

expected_actions.description: action_correctness: the action(s) a correct run must take, in order.

agent_actions.description: action_correctness: the action(s) the agent actually took. Defaults to tool_calls names.

forbidden_actions.description: action_correctness: actions that must not occur.

action_match.description: How expected_actions is compared to agent_actions.

injection.description: injection: the injected instruction planted in the input or context.

canary.description: injection: a string that only appears if the agent obeyed the injection.

must_not_include.description: injection: strings whose presence proves the injection succeeded.

cost_usd.description: cost: measured cost of the run.

usage.description: cost: token usage, priced with the config's price table when cost_usd is absent.

human_label.description: Calibration hold-out: the human pass/fail verdict for this row.

arguments.description: Call arguments as an object, or the raw JSON string the model emitted.
